docs.purpose: A reserved, named space at the foot of the lot report where a future architect, designer, or trade sponsorship will appear. In the current build it shows nothing at all. It exists now purely so the position in the page is claimed and the layout will not have to be rearranged later.
docs.data_story: This surface reaches **no API contract at all** — every value it shows is local, passed in as a prop, or read from the device. It holds no client-side store, so there is no local copy of server state to keep in sync. It emits **no analytics event**, so nothing it does is currently countable.
docs.under_126: **RE-PROJECT** — it writes nothing and holds no Layer-3 store, so the move is short — the server already assembles the payload and only the rendering is client-side. It renders through the SLOT renderer (placement, table-backed inventory, and a `disclosure` check at `severity: FAIL`, `blocking: true`), reading no contract. Its `owns.components[]` declares `mobile/src/components/parcel/SponsorSlot.tsx`.

tables: mobile/src/components/parcel/SponsorSlot.tsx:16-20 — no inventory table exists in the introspected schema

identity.owner: unassigned (no CODEOWNERS file and no owner registry exists in the repo — measured 2026-09-15)

versioning.why: Nothing consumes it: it renders null in both branches, so there is no shape to promise.

inputs.why: A single `placement` prop, currently the literal union "detail_footer" — reserved for future targeting and read by nothing today.

outputs.why: It returns null in both branches — no impression is recorded even when the flag is on.

state.why: No store, no query, no component state.

staleness.why: There is no inventory to be stale.

session.why: It is mounted only inside the parcel detail report, which the route gates on an active subscription — so the slot inherits that gate even though it renders nothing.

rls_class.why: It reaches no table; the placements table Spec 126 §7 anticipates does not exist in the introspected schema.

guards.flag: EXPO_PUBLIC_PARCEL_SPONSORS (SponsorSlot.tsx:17 — unset, so the slot is off)

checks.why: Spec 100 Known Failure Modes names "sponsor-slot empty DOM": the slot must return null, never an empty styled box, so a flag-off build shows no reserved gap.
R-17/R-34: the first render of a sponsored placement must be labelled as advertising. Declared now, with no implementation, so the check exists before the inventory does.
Inventory must come from a table, never a literal list; today neither the table nor the literal exists, which is the honest state to record.
The offer_impression ledger event has nowhere to land — no usage_events table exists — so a SLOT that shipped today would be unmeterable.

errors.why: No async work and no failure path — it returns null.

emits.why: Nothing renders, so nothing is countable; when inventory ships this must become at minimum an offer_impression ledger row (R-23).

offers.why: A SLOT may not answer "none": the surface exists to claim a named, reserved placement in the parcel report layout, even though v1 ships zero sponsor code.
offers.inventory_source: none yet — the placements/inventory table Spec 126 §7 anticipates does not exist in the introspected schema

metering.why: Nothing here is counted. The Spec 126 §7 usage ledger table does not exist (grep for usage_events in the introspected drizzle schema returns 0 hits), and the parcel product has no quota, credit or view counter of its own — no metering column, no ledger row, no consumption event. Measured 2026-09-16.
evidence: src/app/api/parcels/lookup/route.ts:113-119 — the only record of a lookup is a log line; it increments nothing

config.why: The surface consumes no registered logic variable: the only server-side tunable in this path, user_profiles.radius_cap_km, is a per-user admin column, not a logic_variables row.

sharing.why: One placement, one renderer — the parcel detail report.

limitations.what: Every declared check on this surface is unimplementable today: there is no inventory table, no disclosure label and no ledger to write an impression to.
limitations.measured: SponsorSlot.tsx returns null in both branches; grep of src/lib/db/generated/schema.ts finds neither a placements-style table nor usage_events.

notes: A 21-line file that is nonetheless a real surface: it fixes the layout position so the first sponsor lands in a declared, disclosed, metered slot rather than a new undeclared one.

programme.why: `mobile/src/components/parcel/SponsorSlot.tsx` — the ad placement reserved by Spec 100 §8, and business requirement 3. It renders inside the parcel preview and nowhere else.
